comment: It is too thin, but i think the biggest issue is that it looks like it comes from nowhere and goes nowhere. spring should originate in depressions so they fill up and spill out into a waterfall. So it comes from a pool. Ideally it should also end in a pool. Not sure how we do that because the water in should equal the water out so we don't flood the world, but how do you get it to pool at the bottom first?
